niche.habitat: The Shear Layer (Terminator region, 1-3 km altitude)

body: Translucent ribbed sac, central throat cavity, radial cilia array

skill.effect: Propels unit forward 10m using acoustic push, costs 15 stamina.

journal.en: It sings the wind into motion.

plausibility.summary: Reframe Resonant Thrust as resonant pulse-jet: ribs rhythmically collapse a throat cavity and expel humid air/vapor rings; resonance boosts jet speed and couples to shear (F12). Keep weakness to high-frequency disruption of cavity timing; reserve sky-jelly buoyancy (hot metabolite gas or dilute lift gas) for sustained loft in the terminator belt.

links: Triggers metabolic switch to nitrate digestion

skill.effect: Heals 20% and buffs attack during flare events.

chains.weakness: Blind in low UV; sluggish otherwise

journal.en: The sky burns, and it eats the sky.

plausibility.summary: Quiescent surface UV is low (F28), but flares raise UV 10–100× for hours (F4), matching a flare-pulsed lifestyle. Diet already includes nitrate aerosols; Segura-style flare NOx rain (F22) makes nitrate pulses predictable. Rapid pigment shifts plus UV opsins can cue feeding enzyme induction without requiring chronic high UV at the terminator.

journal.en: Blood that burns and breathes fire.

skill.effect: Locks onto wind current, moves freely for duration.

chains.weakness: Useless in dead calm; drifts in crosswinds

journal.en: It dances on the invisible rivers.

plausibility.summary: F12's stacked circulation (slow surface flow vs faster return aloft) implies persistent shear near 1–3 km at the terminator; a radial array of mechanosensitive cilia can map pressure and flow gradients much like distributed flow sensors. Navigation is gliding on shear with fine steering, not beating 50–60 m/s jets directly.

relations.note: (council kind 'Predator') Cantobrisa hunts juveniles in the shear.

secrets: The song can shatter fulgurite glass.
It can mimic the flare's UV signature to trick prey.
moments: When the flare hits, the Cantobrisa stops moving. It opens its ribs to the sky, and the air itself turns to glass and food.

journal.en: It doesn't fly; it argues with the air until the air gives way.
Flares make it hungry. The sky is its meal.
